name: pace-shards-happy
_comment: Session-ten REAL-TIME pacing scenario (engine_pacing_tests.py): the Shards FR Latest happy path — dig-confirm proof, walk-back-to-PAN reach, momentum rattle drain, settle, second dig — with every decision instant at least 50 ms away from every threshold it meets (NO_PROGRESS_SEC=1 window, SHAKE_BAIL_MS=500, budgets). The classic-shards-live choreography is deliberately NOT reused here: it parks the R2 no-progress branch 2 ms from its 1000 ms window (fine on the dust-free virtual clock, a coin flip under real-hardware jitter), and a pacing suite must measure pacing, not flip knife edges. Wall-clock runs replay this in ~1.4 s. Not a golden; input fixture only.
